model_view.prompt_facts:
SCENARIO UNDER REVIEW: Base case
What changes in this scenario: No stress or action applied; this is the baseline forecast.
Opening cash: SGD 420.0k. Minimum cash reserve: SGD 150.0k. Horizon: 13 weeks.

KEY FIGURES FOR THIS SCENARIO:
- Base case: reserve maintained; lowest closing cash SGD 341.1k in Week 2, SGD 191.1k above the SGD 150.0k reserve.

OTHER CASES (context only):
- Customer delay: reserve breached from Week 4; lowest closing cash SGD 146.4k in Week 4, SGD 3.6k below the SGD 150.0k reserve; below reserve for 1 week(s); back above reserve in Week 5. Lowest cash is SGD 194.7k lower than the base case (SGD 341.1k).
- Supplier deferral: reserve maintained; lowest closing cash SGD 358.3k in Week 3, SGD 208.3k above the SGD 150.0k reserve. Lowest cash is SGD 17.2k higher than the base case (SGD 341.1k).
- Combined stress: reserve maintained; lowest closing cash SGD 351.4k in Week 4, SGD 201.4k above the SGD 150.0k reserve. Lowest cash is SGD 10.3k higher than the base case (SGD 341.1k).
- Accelerated receipt action: reserve maintained; lowest closing cash SGD 371.1k in Week 2, SGD 221.1k above the SGD 150.0k reserve. Lowest cash is SGD 30.0k higher than the base case (SGD 341.1k).

MANAGEMENT LEVERS ALREADY MODELLED:
- Bringing 8 eligible invoices (SGD 466.0k in total) forward by 7 days is modelled as a separate hypothetical action; lowest cash would be SGD 371.1k in Week 2. It moves timing only and needs customer agreement.
- Deferring eligible supplier payments is a timing change only and needs supplier agreement; payroll, tax, statutory dues and debt repayment are protected.
